app-templates.message:
fix(quiz): images at 800 px; the quiz-material job copies its images into an existing folder

## Intent

The seven images made the quiz page about 33 times as large as its script and styles, and the page must stay light on a phone. The CI job quiz-material also failed once the quiz had an image folder of its own, because it copied its test images into a nested folder.

## Key changes

- Every image is at most 800 px wide and more strongly compressed: about 450 kB in all instead of 737 kB.
- The job quiz-material creates the image folder and copies the content of the fixture's image folder into it, whether the folder exists or not.

## Dependencies and side effects

- app-templates 1583231 lets the browser load each image only when it is needed.

app-templates.reason: A runtime change on a branch of its own.
app-templates.message:
feat: load figure images lazily

## Intent

The browser fetched the images of every question at once, even those the learner has not reached yet. A quiz with an image at every question should load only what is shown.

## Key changes

- Images of questions and explainer pages carry loading=lazy and decoding=async.

## Dependencies and side effects

- app-templates 51ae9b0 makes the images of the Naturwunder-Quiz smaller.

moved.why: Lazy loading answers the worry about the size of the quiz raised here; the steering session only passed the decision on.
